summary.headline: Lunar Configurations and Astrological Lots
summary.text: Catalog entries for a Venetian astrological codex covering lunar conjunctions and void-of-course conditions, nodal conjunctions, lunar configurations with stars, planetary transitions through the zodiac, stellar aspects, terms, the twelve places, Persian lots, and traveler omens. The notice records missing leaves containing the end of Achmet’s first book and beginning of the second, followed by entries on departing and arriving travelers.
